# The Tuva Project Demo

This project loads a 1,000 patient synthetic claims and clinical dataset into the
input layer and runs the Tuva package on it. This page maps the **downstream
artifacts (exposures)** that consume the Tuva data marts back to the models and
demo inputs they depend on. Open any exposure under *Exposures* in the sidebar, or
use the lineage graph (bottom-right icon) with `+exposure:<name>` to see its full
upstream DAG.

*This page is generated by `scripts/generate_lineage_doc.py`; do not edit by hand.*

## Exposures

| Exposure | Type | Maturity | Directly depends on | Upstream nodes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Financial PMPM Dashboard** (`financial_pmpm_dashboard`) | dashboard | medium | `core__member_months`, `financial_pmpm__pmpm_payer`, `financial_pmpm__pmpm_payer_plan` | 235 |
| **Pharmacy Generic Opportunity Analysis** (`pharmacy_generic_opportunity`) | analysis | low | `pharmacy__brand_generic_opportunity`, `pharmacy__pharmacy_claim_expanded` | 26 |
| **Population Health Dashboard** (`population_health_dashboard`) | dashboard | medium | `chronic_conditions__cms_chronic_conditions_wide`, `chronic_conditions__tuva_chronic_conditions_wide`, `core__patient`, `ed_classification__summary` | 301 |
| **Provider Attribution Panel** (`provider_attribution_panel`) | application | low | `provider_attribution__assigned_beneficiaries_current`, `provider_attribution__assigned_beneficiaries_yearly`, `provider_attribution__provider_ranking` | 230 |
| **Quality Measures Scorecard** (`quality_measures_scorecard`) | dashboard | medium | `quality_measures__summary_counts`, `quality_measures__summary_wide` | 343 |
| **Hospital Readmissions Report** (`readmissions_report`) | analysis | medium | `readmissions__encounter_augmented`, `readmissions__readmission_summary` | 279 |
| **CMS-HCC Risk Adjustment Dashboard** (`risk_adjustment_dashboard`) | dashboard | medium | `cms_hcc__patient_risk_factors`, `cms_hcc__patient_risk_scores`, `cms_hcc__patient_risk_scores_monthly` | 263 |
